protocol_differences: GPT-4o perturbation generator replaced with user-authorized local Qwen3-1.7B
Local model proposes sparse antonym edits; actual counts and unmet budgets are retained
Standard RAG with Flan-T5-large and BM25, both model choices evaluated in paper
BM25 implemented with explicit sklearn unigram tokenization and Lucene IDF; not FlashRAG tokenizer
Uses the public BEIR TREC-COVID release; exact document count is recorded rather than assumed
Decision-reversal and distribution-aware variants use fixed 0.03 perturbation magnitude from released perturb.py
Local generator selects direct WordNet adjective/adverb antonyms; this lexical constraint differs from original GPT-4o free rewriting
Unscorable documents receive no score and are disclosed in coverage; any exclusions make evaluation conditional
